617:t_027:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So this is the light of people's hearts...」

617:t_027:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's warm... Power is welling up from the depths of my heart.」

617:t_028:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$! Now you can no longer use $$地球の次元力$$!」

617:t_028:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Gathering the strength of the Earthlings you called foolish and feeble, we'll take you down!」

617:t_028:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Prepare yourself, $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! We'll liberate Earth from you!」

617:t_028:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「We'll do it with the feelings and strength of everyone who's fighting!」

617:t_028:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! This is a fight between the entire Earth and me!」

617:t_028:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But the one who wins is me!」

617:t_028:7.en:
$n
「I'll give you the answer to that right away, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

617:t_028:8.en:
$n
「When that time comes, the $$新地球皇国$$ will fall! With our victory - the victory of $c!!」

617:t_029:2.en:
$$葵$$
「If you're calling yourself a $$次元将$$, then admit defeat gracefully!」

617:t_029:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「The old villain specialty - lashing out after you lose!」

617:t_029:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...Ha ha ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!」

617:t_029:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「W-what the heck!? Did a screw in your head pop out or something!」

617:t_029:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I thank you, $c! I've learned that I still have room to grow stronger!」

617:t_029:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As thanks for that, I'll return Earth to you!」

617:t_029:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But from here on is the true battle between you and me!」

617:t_029:11.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「One day you will encounter the fundamental calamity! Let us meet again at that time!」

617:t_030:0.en:
$$シオニー$$
(Farewell, $$アウストラリス$$... No, $$ヴィルダーク$$...)

617:t_030:1.en:
$$シオニー$$
(I pray that there is a future beyond your fight...)

617:t_030:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「He made sore-loser noises, but it looks like he admitted we won.」

617:t_030:4.en:
$$桂$$
「And besides, the Emperor himself said he would return Earth!」

617:t_030:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now that the Emperor has fallen and withdrawn from the imperial capital, the $$新地球皇国$$ has collapsed.」

617:t_031:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Reports of the Empire's forces retreating and routed are coming in from fronts everywhere, too.」

617:t_031:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Once they learn their leader has been defeated, the fronts still engaged will end up in the same situation.」

617:t_031:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「Will they retreat to the center of the galaxy...?」

617:t_031:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「Even so, they may appear on Earth again.」

617:t_031:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We'll deal with that when it happens! First, let's celebrate the victory!」

617:t_031:5.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「A report has also come in from the ground forces that stormed the Imperial Palace: they have confirmed the people who were held in the $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

617:t_031:6.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Furthermore, the safety of Vice Foreign Minister $$ナナリー・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, Representative $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$ and Princess $$マリナ・イスマイール$$ has also been confirmed.」

617:t_031:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(Heh... I can tell you sighed with relief, even through the mask.)

617:t_031:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But problems are piling up. Some soldiers will probably keep fighting even after losing their leader.」

617:t_031:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「Right. And on top of that, we have to rebuild the $$地球連邦$$.」

617:t_031:11.en:
$$ルカ$$
「There's also the reconstruction of every region, starting with the infrastructure.」

617:t_031:12.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「We'd better hurry up and tear down the bases and $$レイライン$$s everywhere, too.」

617:t_031:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「And we still don't know the whereabouts of $$超銀河ダイグレン$$, which they captured.」

617:t_031:14.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「At worst, it might already have been thrown into the front at the galactic center.」

617:t_031:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And we also still don't know why the $$サイデリアル$$ would not allow Earthlings to evolve...」

617:t_031:16.en:
$n
「So the fight against them still goes on...」

617:t_031:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Um... I'm sorry to intrude while you're basking in the afterglow of victory, but...」

617:t_031:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We've received word that a large force of $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ has appeared at the wormhole on the outskirts of the $$地球圏$$.」

617:t_032:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's over, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

617:t_032:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You beat me, $c! I gave it everything I had, too!」

617:t_032:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「It was the best! So good I don't have a single regret!」

617:t_032:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But I can't hand this life or my $$スフィア$$ over to you guys!」

617:t_033:0.en:
$$メール$$
「Talk all cool, and in the end you run away!」

617:t_033:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Leave her, $$メール$$! Right now, bringing down $$ラース・バビロン$$ comes first!」

617:t_033:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「First we drag the Emperor out and rescue the people caught in that building!」

617:t_034:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're sloppy, $$エルーナルーナ$$. Your name as Supreme Commander of the Empire's forces is weeping.」

617:t_035:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
(The time of the pact may be near, $$エルーナルーナ$$...)

617:t_036:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still keeping your cool at a time like this! Not cute at all, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

617:t_036:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait up! You planning to run!?」

617:t_036:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Even if my battle is over, our battle is not.」

617:t_037:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「He can't fight anymore. Settling it can wait.」

617:t_037:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
(So long, $$尸空#pilot$$... Don't let me see that gloomy face again.)

617:t_038:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「How disgraceful, $$尸空#pilot$$. Fated to perish anyway - that's all $$鬼宿$$ ever were.」

617:t_039:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
(Bye-bye, $$尸空#pilot$$. We might meet again, though...)

617:t_040:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Why!? Why can't I beat them!」

617:t_040:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you want to know, I'll tell you, $$バルビエル$$!」

617:t_040:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Hatred is bound to collapse someday! Because your power is not infinite!」

617:t_040:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, $$ゼロ$$! What do you know about me!」

617:t_040:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Because I used to be the same as you.」
